Title: Stand-in Tier+Tactical Tier 1
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_Package_Tier1 folder name and
the shape of the Tier+Tactical scripts its port reads (TT_maxAmmo and
TT_ammoType items, TT_raycast images, the TT_ check state scripts and the
onFire, onReloaded and damage methods), so the listed port applies to it. It
is not the original Add-On and holds none of its files, and its guns, names
and numbers are its own.
